blocks.text: As you become a teenager, however, you may sometimes begin to question adults' idea, instead of blindly accepting their ideas as you did when you were a small child. You gradually become aware that you are a unique person with your own ideas and attitudes. For example, you begin to make choices of your own about your lifestyle. To put it another way, you will find that you want to put your life together in the way that you think is best for you.
